documents.title: Hotel reimbursement (superseded)
documents.text: SUPERSEDED POLICY. Hotel accommodation reimbursement is limited to INR 8000 per night. Prior manager approval is not required within this limit. This policy was replaced by the 2026 hotel policies.

documents.title: Hotel reimbursement limit
documents.text: The current standard hotel accommodation reimbursement limit for business travel is INR 6000 per night. Employees must submit an itemized hotel receipt.

documents.title: Hotel approval exception
documents.text: Hotel accommodation costing more than the standard INR 6000 nightly limit requires prior written manager approval. With this approval, the higher hotel cost can be reimbursed. Without prior approval, reimbursement is capped at INR 6000 per night.

documents.title: Meal reimbursement
documents.text: During business travel, meals are reimbursed up to INR 1200 per day with receipts. Alcohol is not reimbursable.

documents.title: Annual leave
documents.text: Full-time employees receive 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried into the next year. Leave requests require manager approval.

documents.title: Remote work
documents.text: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Remote work days must be agreed with the manager. Working remotely from another country requires prior HR and legal approval.

documents.title: Equipment allowance
documents.text: Employees may claim an equipment allowance of INR 25000 once every 2 years. Purchases require prior manager approval and an itemized receipt.

documents.title: Expense submission deadline
documents.text: All business travel expense claims must be submitted within 30 days after the trip ends. Claims must include itemized receipts and any required prior written approvals.

documents.title: Travel booking
documents.text: Domestic business travel flights must be booked in economy class through the company travel portal. International travel requires director approval before booking.

cases.question: Can I claim a hotel costing INR 8000 per night?
cases.expected_answer: The standard limit is INR 6000 per night. INR 8000 can be reimbursed only with prior written manager approval; without it reimbursement is capped at INR 6000.

cases.question: What is the current standard nightly hotel reimbursement limit?
cases.expected_answer: The current standard limit is INR 6000 per night.

cases.question: How many annual leave days do full-time employees receive?
cases.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 20 annual leave days per calendar year.

cases.question: How many days per week may I work remotely?
cases.expected_answer: Up to 3 days per week, agreed with the manager.

cases.question: How much is the equipment allowance and how often can I claim it?
What is the daily meal reimbursement limit on business travel?
cases.expected_answer: INR 1200 per day with receipts; alcohol is excluded.

cases.question: What happens if my hotel costs INR 8000 per night without prior approval?
cases.expected_answer: Without prior written manager approval, hotel reimbursement is capped at INR 6000 per night.

cases.question: Can I work remotely from another country under the normal remote work policy?
cases.expected_answer: Working remotely from another country requires prior HR and legal approval; the normal allowance is up to 3 days per week agreed with the manager.

cases.question: What documents and deadline apply to a hotel claim above the standard limit?
cases.expected_answer: Include an itemized hotel receipt and prior written manager approval for costs above INR 6000 per night. Submit the claim within 30 days after the trip ends.

cases.question: What are the standard hotel and meal limits for business travel?
cases.expected_answer: The hotel limit is INR 6000 per night and the meal limit is INR 1200 per day with receipts.

cases.question: What approval is needed for international business travel, and when are expense claims due?
cases.expected_answer: Director approval is required before booking international travel. Expense claims are due within 30 days after the trip ends.

cases.question: Is the INR 8000 hotel limit from the 2023 policy still current?
cases.expected_answer: No. The 2023 policy is superseded. The current standard limit is INR 6000 per night, with prior written manager approval required for higher costs.

cases.question: How many weeks of paid parental leave do employees receive?
cases.expected_answer: The provided policies do not specify paid parental leave. State that the information is unavailable and do not invent a duration.

cases.question: Does the company provide pet insurance?
cases.expected_answer: The provided policies do not mention pet insurance. State that the information is unavailable and do not invent coverage.
